summary: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships are limited 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships from University College Dublin for outstanding international students on non-EU fees who start an eligible undergraduate or graduate taught programme in Dublin in September 2027. Applications for the 2027/28 round are now open and close on regional dates between 1 February and 31 March 2027. A committee of staff from UCD's six Colleges chooses recipients on academic merit and answers to the scholarship questions.
eligibility_notes:
You must be classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes and for UCD admissions, and be self-funding. The scholarship is for new entrants to an eligible programme starting in September; it is not for research degrees, and the programme must be taught in Dublin with no part of the degree awarded by another institution.

Before you can apply for the scholarship you must already hold one of these statuses on an application to an eligible UCD programme: Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept.

Regional rules: North America (Canada, USA, American Samoa, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam) is undergraduate only and applicants must be citizens of the region; North American graduate applicants use the 'all other regions' route. South Asia (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka) is graduate only and applicants must be citizens; South Asian undergraduates use the 'all other regions' route. Middle East, Africa and Pakistan covers undergraduate and graduate applicants from the countries listed in the Terms and Conditions (including, for example, Algeria, Egypt, Ghana, Iran, Iraq, Kenya, Nigeria, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Turkey and the United Arab Emirates). All other regions: applicants may be citizens and/or residents of any country outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland.

Excluded programmes: online programmes, January-start programmes, part-time programmes, clinical programmes, off-shore campus programmes, and the UCD International Study Centre International Foundation Year Pathway.

The scholarship cannot be combined with any other tuition fee scholarship. If you hold offers for several programmes, only one programme can be considered. Any material misrepresentation in the application means immediate disqualification.

No minimum grade, age limit or language score is stated for the scholarship itself; the programme application carries its own entry rules, which were not part of the pages read.
funding_summary: Successful applicants receive either a 100% or a 50% tuition fee scholarship, paid only toward the tuition fees charged for the programme. It does not cover the students' union fee (Aontas na Mac Leinn in Eireann, AMLE) that applies to all students, or any other charges needed to finish the programme. It is renewed automatically each year of the programme if the student keeps a Stage GPA of 3.08 out of 4.20 and meets progression and credit rules. The scholarship does not pay for tuition on extra modules above the standard credit load.
programmes_note: Many undergraduate and graduate taught programmes in all six UCD Colleges are eligible, but some are excluded; check the published Eligible Programmes list for 2027/28 (it may change). Programmes must be full-time and Dublin-based. The list is organised by College and School, with programme codes.
institutions_note: University College Dublin only. The scholarship is tied to the programme and start date in your offer letter.

requirements.text: An application to an eligible UCD programme that already has the status Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept. Apply to the programme as early as possible: UCD cannot promise every programme application is processed before the scholarship deadline. Applicants without an offer must submit the programme application by 5 February 2027 to leave time for an offer before the 28 February deadline.
UCD Connect login (8-digit ID number and password) from the programme application portal, used to open the scholarship application in the student system.

Answers to the 'General Questions' in the scholarship application. They cover motivation for studying at UCD, alignment with UCD values, experience and achievements, contributions to equality, diversity and inclusion, and potential to act as a UCD ambassador. No word limit is stated.
If you hold offers for more than one programme, state which single programme should be considered for the scholarship.
requirements.conditional_rule: applicants with offers for several programmes

requirements.text: Online acceptance of the scholarship offer within the time set by the UCD scholarships team, and payment of the deposit when accepting the UCD place.

application_steps.title: Check eligibility and the eligible programme list
application_steps.detail: You need non-EU fee status, a full-time taught undergraduate or graduate programme in Dublin from the 2027/28 eligible list, and citizenship or residence that fits the regional rules. Online, January-start, part-time, clinical and off-shore programmes and the International Foundation Year Pathway are excluded.

application_steps.title: Apply to your UCD programme and get an offer
application_steps.detail: Submit the programme application early. You need the status Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept before the scholarship link appears. Middle East, Africa and Pakistan applicants without an offer should apply to the programme by 5 February 2027.

application_steps.title: Open Scholarship Applications in the student system
application_steps.detail: Log in with UCD Connect using your 8-digit ID number and the same password as the programme application portal, choose Applications, then Scholarship Applications, and select the Global Excellence Scholarship. The link only shows if the call is open, you meet the regional rules and your programme status is Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept.

application_steps.title: Answer the general questions and submit before your deadline
application_steps.detail: Submit before 11.59pm Irish time on your regional deadline: 1 February 2027 (North American undergraduates), 28 February 2027 (Middle East, Africa, Pakistan; South Asian graduates), or 31 March 2027 (all other applicants). Only complete applications received on time are considered, and only one programme can be considered.

application_steps.title: Committee review on merit and your answers
application_steps.detail: A committee of staff from UCD's six Colleges, supported by UCD Global, reviews applications on academic merit together with a holistic review of your answers. A limited number of students are chosen per region for either a 100% or a 50% tuition scholarship, and reserve candidates are also selected.

application_steps.title: Receive the result
application_steps.detail: Results are shared in the student system about seven weeks after each regional deadline, and candidates are told within two weeks of the committee's decision. The committee's decisions are final and cannot be appealed.

application_steps.title: Accept the scholarship online and pay the deposit
application_steps.detail: Accept the scholarship offer online within the time set by the UCD scholarships team; no reply counts as declining, and a lapsed or declined offer cannot be restored. You must also pay the deposit when accepting your UCD place to secure both the place and the scholarship. Holders of the 100% scholarship get the deposit refunded after registering at UCD.

application_steps.title: Keep the award: stay enrolled and meet the GPA
application_steps.detail: The scholarship is non-transferable, cannot be deferred and applies only to the programme and start date in your offer letter. You must stay continuously enrolled full-time; withdrawing, becoming inactive, part-time enrolment, suspension or dismissal ends it, with limited reinstatement for approved medical or extenuating reasons. A formal Leave of Absence of up to one academic year can keep the award. It renews automatically each year with a Stage GPA of 3.08 out of 4.20 and progression and credit requirements met; awards are typically applied by October.

application_steps.title: Contribute to UCD promotion
application_steps.detail: By accepting, you agree to contribute to at least one of these as reasonably directed by UCD: social media content, website content, being an ambassador on the peer-to-peer platform, discussion groups, panels or surveys, or other promotional events.
